text:
DeployBot: scheduled rollout started: release=v2.9.1, target=model:redwood-open-7b-v2-q4, runtime=rtx-pool. change_window=2h. canary_policy=region-based. docs: https://internal/redwood/releases/v2.9.1 :rocket:
Alice (eng-releases): starting quick capacity + health checks across US/EU/APAC. tagging @Carla (sre) for pool numbers.
Carla (sre): US (rtx-pool): 80/100 GPUs free. EU: 18/40 (higher churn, ~70% utilization last hour). APAC: 6/20 (we have scheduled maintenance in ap-syd at 18:00 UTC). recommendation: cap APAC canary and avoid parallel bursts.
Dinesh (ml): note: v2.9.1 changes KV cache allocation (~+12% memory on long context). EU's smaller instance types might OOM under high concurrency. if EU latency or OOMs appear, we should pin EU to v2.9.0-q4 (older quant profile).
Ben (devex): proposed canary percentages: US=5% -> step to 20% after 15m, EU=2% -> hold if any p95>900ms, APAC=0.5% then manual. sound ok?
Eva (product): also need release notes posted and a short customer heads-up for customers with dedicated capacity in EU/APAC. i'll draft a banner.
Alice (eng-releases): ok initiating canaries. command: ```deployctl rollout start --release v2.9.1 --regions us,eu,apac --canary 5,2,0.5 --runtime rtx-pool```
DeployBot: canary jobs queued. us-canary(id=cb-331), eu-canary(id=cb-332), apac-canary(id=cb-333). will report metrics every 2m.
Carla (sre): us-canary ok at 10m: p50=120ms p95=380ms p99=720ms errors=0.2%. eu-canary initial: p50=180ms p95=760ms p99=1400ms errors=0.6%. apac-canary traffic extremely low, no signals yet.
Dinesh (ml): EU p99=1400ms is concerning given kv growth. could be cache miss regen. recommend throttling EU canary to 1% and pin to v2.9.0-q4 if >1.0% error-rate or p99>1200ms for 5m.
Alice (eng-releases): @carla please cap eu canary to 1% and keep us moving. Ben hold APAC until capacity frees.
Carla (sre): applying cap -> ```deployctl canary update cb-332 --percent 1``` -> ACK. also raising autoscaler min on eu-pool by +2 nodes to help tail latency (will take 3-5m to spin).
DeployBot: canary update applied for cb-332 percent=1. autoscaler scale started for eu-pool (+2).
Carla (sre): eu autoscaler nodes coming up. re-checking metrics at +8m: p95=720ms p99=1150ms errors=0.9% trending down. still close to threshold.
Dinesh (ml): if errors continue to hover near 1% let's do a soft pin: route new EU requests to model variant v2.9.0-q4 for 10% of traffic while keeping majority on v2.9.1. that will exercise fallback without full rollback.
Alice (eng-releases): agreed. do soft pin if it helps avoid full rollback. Ben can you prep release note blurb mentioning the quant changes and EU mitigation?
Ben (devex): on it, draft in #eng-releases-drafts in 5m.
Carla (sre): performing soft pin now: ```routingctl set-variant --region eu --route default --variant v2.9.0-q4 --percent 10``` -> deployed.
DeployBot: routing change executed. eu routing: v2.9.1=90% v2.9.0-q4=10%.
Carla (sre): monitoring: after soft pin p99 down to 980ms, errors 0.4%. looks stable.
Dinesh (ml): good sign. continue to monitor for 20m, then we can promote EU to next canary step (5%) if stable.
Alice (eng-releases): agree. advancing US canary to 20% now. ```deployctl canary update cb-331 --percent 20```
DeployBot: us-canary updated to 20%.
Carla (sre): us metrics still clean. eu will stay at 1% until 20m stable window completes. apac still paused (capacity low).
Eva (product): i'll send the customer note for EU dedicated customers: short heads up about limited impact and that we're monitoring. cc: @support.
Alice (eng-releases): decision log: if region p99>1200ms OR errors>2% for 10m -> rollback region to pinned variant v2.9.0-q4. Otherwise proceed with staged promotion. we have autoscaler buffer and soft-pin fallback in place.
Ben (devex): release note posted and banner drafted.
Carla (sre): +20m check: eu p99=870ms p95=680ms errors=0.3%. autoscaler stable. recommend advance eu canary to 5% now.
Alice (eng-releases): advancing eu to 5%: ```deployctl canary update cb-332 --percent 5```
DeployBot: eu-canary updated to 5%.
Carla (sre): apac: still low capacity due to maintenance, recommending schedule APAC promotion for 03:00 UTC when maintenance window ends.
Dinesh (ml): no new model regressions in US/EU for sample evals. good to continue.
Alice (eng-releases): plan: finish phased promotion for US/EU within this change window, APAC deferred to off-peak tomorrow. final checks: anyone object?
Ben (devex): no objections.
Eva (product): no objections, will include APAC timing in the comms.
Carla (sre): done - eu promoted to 20% and monitoring. us is at 60% now (stepped up). no alerts.
DeployBot: status summary: us=60% v2.9.1, eu=20% v2.9.1 (10% fallback variant 0 for a few routes), apac=0.5% paused. overall errors=0.35% p99 global=680ms.
Alice (eng-releases): marking rollout in-progress. we'll keep an eye for remainder of change window. if no regressions, we close and mark GA. thanks team :thumbsup:
Carla (sre): ack. will keep on-call watch for next 30m.
DeployBot: rollout paused for APAC pending capacity. ETA for APAC resume: 03:00 UTC tomorrow.
Dinesh (ml): logging note: follow-up item to profile long-context KV regen and optimize cache sizing for v2.9.x. filing ticket INF-1298.
Alice (eng-releases): added INF-1298 and linking to release notes. closing thread after final verification. everyone drop quick reactions when you see this thread. :eyes:
